title: VectorCraft recipe (steps.json)
description: Exactly what `vectorcraft-cli run --commands FILE` reads (JSON array form), restricted for reproducible deliveries. Enforced in code by scripts/vc_common.py validate_steps(): step 0 is file.new, steps 1-2 are select.none and paint.default (M31); a recipe run on `--in FILE` instead starts with select.none, paint.default (the prefixItems below describe the new-document form), no file/app/plugin/script/prefs commands, no path-like strings (absolute, ~, .., drive letters, file:). The same array runs in MCP as command_batch {steps} when it has at most 256 steps. "$N.path" references are 0-based step indices.
